a: The Azure Region where the Azure Managed Lustre File System should exist. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
The name which should be used for this Azure Managed Lustre File System. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
The name of the Resource Group where the Azure Managed Lustre File System should exist. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
The SKU name for the Azure Managed Lustre File System. Possible values are `AMLFS-Durable-Premium-40`, `AMLFS-Durable-Premium-125`, `AMLFS-Durable-Premium-250` and `AMLFS-Durable-Premium-500`.
The size of the Azure Managed Lustre File System in TiB. The valid values for this field are dependent on which `sku_name` has been defined in the configuration file.
The resource ID of the Subnet that is used for managing the Azure Managed Lustre file system and for client-facing operations.
A list of availability zones for the Azure Managed Lustre File System. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
A mapping of tags which should be assigned to the Azure Managed Lustre File System.
The day of the week on which the maintenance window will occur. Possible values are `Sunday`, `Monday`, `Tuesday`, `Wednesday`, `Thursday`, `Friday` and `Saturday`.
The time of day (in UTC) to start the maintenance window.
The URL to the Key Vault Key used as the Encryption Key. This can be found as `id` on the `azurerm_key_vault_key` resource.
The ID of the source Key Vault. This can be found as `id` on the `azurerm_key_vault` resource.
The resource ID of the storage container that is used for hydrating the namespace and archiving from the namespace. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
The resource ID of the storage container that is used for logging events and errors. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
The import prefix for the Azure Managed Lustre File System. Only blobs in the non-logging container that start with this path/prefix get hydrated into the cluster namespace.
A list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this Azure Managed Lustre File System. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
The type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Azure Managed Lustre File System. Only possible value is `UserAssigned`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
Squash mode of the AML file system. Possible values are `RootOnly`, and `All`.
NID IP Address list(s) to be added to the TrustedSystems, separated by semicolons.
The GID to be used for the root squash. Defaults to `0`.
The UID to be used for the root squash. Defaults to `0`.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when creating the Azure Managed Lustre File System.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when deleting the Azure Managed Lustre File System.
(Defaults to 5 minutes) Used when retrieving the Azure Managed Lustre File System.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when updating the Azure Managed Lustre File System.
